title: Sorting Family Photos
context: Grace 和弟弟 Ryan 整理家里的旧纸质照片，决定如何分类并保存说明。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目是原创口语练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: I found a box of family photos in the closet. Want to sort them with me?
dialogue.zh: 我在壁橱里找到一盒家庭照片。想和我一起整理吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: I'd love to. Some of these pictures are older than I am.
dialogue.zh: 我很乐意。有些照片比我的年纪还大。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Let's start by putting the photos from each trip together.
dialogue.zh: 我们先把每次旅行的照片分别放在一起吧。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Good idea. Where does this beach picture belong?
dialogue.zh: 好主意。这张海滩照片应该放在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: I think it was taken on our trip to Maine. Mom might remember.
dialogue.zh: 我想这是我们去缅因州旅行时拍的。妈妈可能记得。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: I'll put it in a separate pile until we ask her.
dialogue.zh: 问她之前，我先把它放在单独的一摞里。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Could you write the places and dates on these cards?
dialogue.zh: 你能把地点和日期写在这些卡片上吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Sure. I'll leave a blank when we aren't certain.
dialogue.zh: 当然。不确定的地方我会留空。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Then we can put each group in an envelope with its card.
dialogue.zh: 然后我们可以把每组照片和卡片一起放进信封。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Should we make copies of our favorites to share with the family?
dialogue.zh: 我们要不要把最喜欢的照片复制一份，和家人分享？

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Yes. Let's choose a few once we've finished sorting.
dialogue.zh: 好。等整理完后我们挑几张。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.en: Deal. I'll ask Mom about the beach photo this evening.
dialogue.zh: 说定了。我今晚问问妈妈那张海滩照片。

expressions.example: I spent an hour sorting old photos.

expressions.zh: 属于某处；放在合适位置。
expressions.example: Does this photo belong in that folder?
Put the letters in a separate pile.
Leave a blank if you don't know the date.
I'll make copies of these pictures.

pronunciation: photo 重读第一个音节；在 old photos 中注意 old 末尾的 /d/ 和 photos 开头的 /f/ 分属两个词。

practice.title: Part 1 · Photos
practice.prompt: Do you look at old photos often?
practice.answer: Sometimes. I like looking at family photos because they remind me of places and people I love.

practice.title: Part 2 · A photograph you like
practice.prompt: Describe a photograph you like. Say what is in it, when it was taken, and why it matters to you.
practice.answer: One of my favorite photographs shows my family standing on a beach. It was taken during a summer trip when I was a child. My brother is holding a small shell, and everyone is smiling at the camera. I found the picture again while sorting a box with him. It matters to me because it reminds me of a relaxed day we spent together. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Keeping memories
practice.prompt: Why do people keep photographs even when they remember an event?
practice.answer: Photos can bring back details that fade over time, such as a place or a person's expression. They also let people share memories with relatives who were not there.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后提议怎样给照片分类，说明不确定日期时怎么办。
practice.answer: Let's put the trip photos together. I'll write the places on cards and leave a blank if we don't know the date. Then we can choose a few to share.
